domain: reading the exit status line of a CodeBuddy tool result: how the label is spelled and how an acceptance parser must read it
asset_claim: CodeBuddy spells the exit-status label 'Exit Code:' (capital C) in real tool results; a parser that only accepts 'Exit code:' reads null and records a timed-out call (curl -s without -S, exit 28) as unreadable instead of timed out, and curl 52/56 the same way; making the label case-insensitive fixes it, and a regression test should cover the capital spelling for 28, 52, 56 and the lower-case spelling
